# MyTranscript

> MyTranscript (https://www.mytranscript.pro) is a fast, free, multilingual AI platform for YouTube transcription, intelligent video summarization, and interactive chat. Users paste any YouTube video or Shorts URL to instantly extract clean timestamped subtitles, generate chapterized takeaways, create visual infographic prompts, and converse with video content across multiple languages without registration, cookies, or extensions.

## Core Features & Tools

- [YouTube Transcript Generator](https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-transcript): Extract timestamped transcripts, search spoken phrases, copy text, and export clean captions.
- [AI Video Summarizer](https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-summary): Generate executive summaries, 5-10 key actionable takeaways, and timestamped section breakdowns.
- [YouTube Infographic Generator](https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-infographic): Convert complex video explanations into structured diagram prompts, workflows, and visual briefs.
- [YouTube to Text Converter](https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-to-text): Convert video audio into clean, formatted text articles suitable for blogging, study notes, or newsletters.
- [Podcast Transcript Extractor](https://www.mytranscript.pro/podcast-transcript): High-speed transcript extraction for long-form interviews, podcasts, lectures, and panel discussions.
- [Transcript AI Interactive Chat](https://www.mytranscript.pro/transcript-ai): Chat directly with any YouTube video transcript using AI to ask questions, pull quotes, or clarify topics.

## Multilingual Support

MyTranscript provides localized endpoints with tailored metadata, hreflang alternates, and native language models:

- [English](https://www.mytranscript.pro/en): English workspace and transcripts.
- [Español (Spanish)](https://www.mytranscript.pro/es): Transcripción y resúmenes de videos de YouTube con IA.
- [Deutsch (German)](https://www.mytranscript.pro/de): KI-gestützte YouTube-Transkription und Video-Zusammenfassungen.
- [Français (French)](https://www.mytranscript.pro/fr): Transcription et résumé de vidéos YouTube par intelligence artificielle.
- [Português (Portuguese)](https://www.mytranscript.pro/pt): Transcrição de vídeos do YouTube e resumos com IA.
- [العربية (Arabic)](https://www.mytranscript.pro/ar): استخراج نصوص وفيديوهات يوتيوب وتلخيصها بالذكاء الاصطناعي مع دعم كامل للكتابة من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL).

## Technical Architecture & Privacy

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, and Tailwind CSS with Edge-optimized server-side rendering and responsive dark theme.
- **AI Engine**: Integrated with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and OpenRouter LLM gateways for near-instant inference and high-context comprehension.
- **Privacy First**: Zero persistent user tracking, no forced authentication, and client-side credential protection. User summaries are generated on demand.
